meta.title: Financial reports
meta.description: Monthly income and expense reports of Al Muttaqin Cultural Center, verified by the treasurer and published for every donor.

title: Every yen, reported every month
description: Your infaq deserves a clear account. Each month the treasurer publishes opening balance, income, expenses, and closing balance, reviewed by the board.

1.title: Verified by the treasurer
1.text: Every figure is reconciled with the bank statement and the QRIS settlement before publishing.

2.title: Signed by two people
2.text: The treasurer prepares the report and the chairperson approves it.

3.title: Released by the 5th
3.text: The report for the previous month is published by the fifth day of the following month.

4.title: Open to questions
4.text: Donors may request the detailed ledger at the office during opening hours.
